'''Daawis''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Daawis participated in a scouting mission to [[Seymarti V]] where his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] was damaged in a skirmish with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
